messages:
Marta: Quick kickoff  we need a compact social push for next week's launch: X announcement + 3-tweet thread, LinkedIn longform, and a 20s demo clip. Deliverables: 2 hero images, clip trimmed, 2 copy variants, and HubSpot mapping for webinar regs. Drafts by Mon EOD pls.
Devin: I can produce hero images and edit the clip. Which stat should be hero copy: cost reduction or throughput uplift?
Yuna: Use cost on the hero ("~40% lower inference cost") and call out 2x throughput in the thread. That balances procurement + eng interest.
Caleb: I'll draft copy variants: A metric-first, B customer-story. Will keep the first line <280 chars for X preview and add UTMs.
Marta: UTMs: utm_campaign=launch_spark, utm_content=A|B. All webinar regs must create HubSpot contact with properties "social_series":"launch_spark" and "social_variant". Ops please confirm Segment -> HubSpot mapping includes social_variant.
crm-bot: Reminder: include key "social_variant" in registration payload. Test workflow will run once assets are uploaded.
Devin: Uploaded drafts: https://files.redwood/launch/hero_cost_v1.png and https://files.redwood/launch/clip20s_v1.mp4. Filenames include variant suffix when I export final.
Yuna: Reviewed clip  trim first 0.8s, add 1.5s end-frame CTA with shortlink go.red/spark, reduce music. Also add caption overlay for accessibility.
Caleb: Posted copy drafts: https://docs.redwood/launch-copy-A and -B. Both include UTM placeholders. Will shorten A for X preview.
Marta: Schedule proposal: X announcement Tues 9:30am PT, follow-up thread 2h later with demo, LinkedIn longform Wed 10am PT. Buffer scheduling ok?
Devin: Works. I'll label assets heroA/heroB and clipA/clipB so analytics maps variants.
crm-bot: HubSpot workflow created (wf_launch_spark). Test contact routed: tag=launch_spark, social_variant=A, owner=SDR-rotation. Webhook to #sales-inbound confirmed.
Yuna: I'll write 3 quick reply scripts for engagement (thanks, question, demo invite) and post them in the doc.
Marta: One extra ask: mark registrants -> nurture; attendees -> SDR hot leads. Add an "urgent" flag if company_size>500 or industry contains "security". Ops to implement.
Devin: Will add metadata in asset folder and compress clip for X (<12MB). Final files will be uploaded by Mon EOD.
Caleb: I'll QA copy for accessibility (alt text) and add UTM-ified shortlinks. Ping me for final approval.
Marta: Amazing 680 thanks team. I'll review drafts tomorrow morning and approve in Buffer.
